findings.message: Nested explicit or iterator-driven work may multiply input cardinalities.
findings.suggestion: Check for indexing/grouping, a set/map, sorting plus scan, batching, or a direct single-pass algorithm.
findings.proposed_complexity: Often O(sum of cardinalities) or O(n log n)

findings.message: .collect() materializes data inside iteration.
findings.suggestion: Fuse the consumer or reuse a buffer when ownership and readability permit; retain materialization at real boundaries.

findings.message: .contains() inside iteration may repeatedly scan another input.
findings.suggestion: Confirm receiver type/cardinality; precompute an index or combine passes only when semantics and size justify it.

findings.message: .all() inside iteration may repeatedly scan another input.

findings.message: format! inside iteration allocates a new String.
findings.suggestion: If measured hot, write into a reused/preallocated buffer; keep format! when it is clearer and cost is immaterial.

findings.message: .clone() inside iteration may allocate or increment ownership counts.
findings.suggestion: Inspect ownership and profiles; borrow or move only if the value's required lifetime and semantics permit it.
